description: Eligible since 2009 and never contributed? You have $109,000 of TFSA room in 2026. Add your deposits, withdrawals and years abroad to see your exact room. Web page: https://calcbright.com/tfsa-calculator

back.description: Year you moved back (optional) Leave empty if you still live abroad.

contributed.description: Total contributed so far All contributions ever, including 2026 and any re-deposits.

eligible.description: Year you turned 18 (or became a resident) Room starts in 2009 at the earliest.

left.description: Year you left Canada (optional) Became a non-resident, e.g. moved to Dubai or Riyadh.

withdrawn.description: Withdrawals before 2026 They came back as room on 1 January of the next year.

withdrawnNow.description: Withdrawals in 2026 (optional) Added back on 1 January 2027, not now.
